# artifact

Turns a diff, branch, or pull request into one HTML file that explains what moved, why it moved, and what a reviewer should look at first. The page carries its own styles and scripts, so it opens in a browser with no server behind it.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`explain-diff-html`](skills/explain-diff-html/README.md) | Use when the user asks for a rich explanation of a code change, diff, branch, or PR. Produces HTML output. |

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install artifact@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add artifact@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install artifact@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
